caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a shaker, placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The shaker has a rounded, vertically elongated body that tapers toward the top. The main body is transparent or glass-like, with a ribbed texture running diagonally around it, and a horizontal raised band decorated with a beaded pattern. The base is wider and features vertical grooves, while the top is capped with a metallic or dark-toned perforated lid, likely for dispensing contents. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale, utilizing shades of gray to indicate light and shadow, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. There are no other objects or background elements present in the composition.
title: Salt Shaker
